bugs_found: transfer() does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float/string inputs can raise TypeError and Receipt.amount may have inconsistent type
transfer() only rejects identical objects, allowing transfers between two Account instances with the same id
compound_interest() silently truncates fractional years via int(years), producing incorrect results for non-integer durations
compound_interest() raises NotImplementedError for negative rates instead of a validation error
loan_payment() silently truncates fractional months via int(months)
